headline: COL @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 3.93 at LAD 6.24, with a projected total of 10.17. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: COL moved +0.47 runs while LAD moved +0.10, changing the projected margin by +0.37 runs. The projected total climbed +0.57, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Eric Lauer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Teoscar Hernández, Troy Johnston, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Max Muncy because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
